title: fix(cli): os migrate meta --json says when no migration step ran
body:
domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pLAfce3rbrPKLECmj

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XL7p7YBQtLSHX1r2qftEhKw)_

Fixes #28947

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

Clause-② measured: the `--json` answer's members are a documented contract in a published surface. `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` (shipped by `@objectstack/skills`) tells an agent to read `.applied` ("`applied` must be []"), `.todos[].surface` and `.specChanges` off `os migrate meta --json`, and `content/docs/upgrading.mdx` documents `todos` / `absentTodos` under `--all`. This PR adds one member to that answer, so it is a widening. A `Clause-②: yes (widening)` declaration on its own is reviewed on its declaration face at `TIER_DEFAULT`. Metadata-protocol is `none`: nothing a metadata author writes is accepted, refused or read differently.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`os migrate meta --json` 在一步迁移都没跑的时候(空区间,如 `--from 18`;或倒置区间,如 `--from 19`),JSON 多一个成员 `replayedNothing: { reason, widestRange }`,说明「本次什么都没重放」以及更宽的区间里有没有活。人读输出与 JSON 读的是同一个函数;倒置区间的人读文案也改为直说「区间倒置」。
- 为什么改:以前 JSON 对空区间的回答和一次干净的重放一模一样(`applied: []`、`schemaValid: true`、退出码 0),而人读输出会警告「这不代表元数据已是规范形」。脚本或 CI 读 JSON 时,`--from` 写错就会被告知迁移已完成。
- 风险与回滚:纯加法。真正跑了迁移步骤的 JSON 逐字节不变(实测 `--from 17` 输出 2,624,990 字节,掩掉 `duration` 后与 main 同 md5),所有退出码不变,倒置区间不新增拒绝。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta.ts` 的 `readReplayedNothing`(唯一判定)与 `printReplayedNothing`(人读渲染);同文件 `emitJson` 调用里新增的那一行展开。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/migrate-meta-json-replayed-nothing.test.ts`,预期 `Tests 8 passed (8)`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta.ts`**: `printEmptyRangeAnswer` is split into one reading and one renderer.
  - `readReplayedNothing(stack, result)` returns `null` when the run replayed at least one step (`result.hops.length > 0`), and otherwise `{ reason, widestRange }`. `reason` is `inverted-range` when `--from` is above `--to` and `empty-range` otherwise. `widestRange` is `null` when no wider range exists (`--to` already reaches the chain terminus, or `--from` is at or above it, so any range from that `--from` is itself empty or inverted), and otherwise `{ from, to, applied, manual }` from the same widest-chain probe the human answer always ran (`applyMetaMigrationsToPackages` over the same normalized stack, manual counted through `listedTodos`).
  - `printReplayedNothing` renders that answer. The empty-range outcomes print the same text as before, except that an inverted range from a `--from` at or above the terminus (`--from T --to T-1`) now prints the no-wider-range line rather than `The widest range this build carries (protocol T → T) has nothing for this stack either`. An inverted range now prints `--from N is above --to M, so the range is inverted and this run replayed nothing — that is not a finding that the metadata is canonical.` in place of `No migration step exists for protocol N → M, …`.
  - The `--json` payload spreads `replayedNothing` in after `hops` only when the reading is non-null, so a run that replayed a step keeps its old payload byte for byte. Exit codes are untouched everywhere, and `--from` above the terminus is answered, not refused.
- **`packages/cli/test/normalized-call-sites.test.ts`**: a `packages` row for `migrate/meta.ts :: readReplayedNothing(normalized`. The census caught the new call site in the unit tier. The function's only stack read is the widest-range probe, which goes through `applyMetaMigrationsToPackages` (the row above it), so package bodies are counted.
- **`.changeset/28947-migrate-meta-json-replayed-nothing.md`**: `@objectstack/cli` patch with both declaration lines.

## Tests

- New `packages/cli/test/migrate-meta-json-replayed-nothing.test.ts` (unit tier by behaviour: in-process `MigrateMeta.run`, nothing spawned, no kernel). Every range is derived from `MIGRATION_MAJORS` / `PROTOCOL_MAJOR`, and no major is hard-coded. 8 cases:
  - guard: the registry has a step at the terminus `T`, and `T-1` is at or above the support floor;
  - `--from T --json`: `replayedNothing` is `{ reason: 'empty-range', widestRange: null }`, exit 0;
  - `--from T --to T --json`: the same;
  - `--from T+1 --json`: `{ reason: 'inverted-range', widestRange: null }`, exit 0 (not refused);
  - `--from T --to T-1` and `--from T+1 --to T-1`: `{ reason: 'inverted-range', widestRange: null }` (seat review: a widest range from a `--from` at or above the terminus is itself empty or inverted);
  - `--from T-1 --to T-1`: `widestRange` names `T-1 → T`, and the human run prints the same counts (face parity);
  - human `--from T+1` names the inverted range;
  - control `--from T-1 --json` (a real replay): no marker, and `Object.keys` equals the ten members the payload carried before.
- **Red first** on `main`'s code (`135054eb`): 5 failed / 2 passed. The guard and the real-replay control were green. The `--from T --to T-1` case added on review was red first at `4066e3ac` (1 failed / 7 passed: `widestRange` came back `{ from: T, to: T, … }`).
- **Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit once each, restored to the HEAD blob `155f6cd4` with `git diff HEAD` empty). The test imports `src/` directly, so no build sits on the path.
  - The JSON spread replaced with an empty spread: 4 failed / 3 passed (the four JSON marker cases).
  - `reason` pinned to `'empty-range'`: 2 failed / 5 passed (the inverted JSON case and the inverted human case).
  - The `fromMajor >= CHAIN_TERMINUS_MAJOR` arm of the no-wider-range guard removed: 1 failed / 7 passed (the `--from T --to T-1` case); restored to the HEAD blob `6da11573`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Byte identity of a real replay**, measured with the built CLI on a canonical stack: `--from 17 --json` on `main` and on this branch are 2,624,990 bytes each, and both hash to md5 `6edb407e…` with `duration` masked.

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured on `main` first** (canonical scratch stack, built CLI at `135054eb`): `--from 18 --json`, `--from 19 --json` and `--from 18 --to 18 --json` all exited 0 with `applied: []`, `todos: []`, `schemaValid: true` and no member saying no step ran. The human runs printed the `replayed nothing` warning. Control `--from 17 --json` exited 0 with 448 todos (21 absent). On this branch the three empty runs carry `replayedNothing`, and `--from 17 --to 17 --json` answers `{ reason: 'empty-range', widestRange: { from: 17, to: 18, applied: 0, manual: 427 } }`. The human run prints the same `0 mechanical and 427 manual`.
- **The human face changed for the inverted range only.** It follows from the one reading: the JSON reason says the range is inverted, so the human line says so too. No existing pin reads that line, and the empty-range lines are byte-identical.

## Verification

All at head `ec0c6421` (base `135054eb`, `origin/main` when the branch was cut). `main` has moved since; no conflict is reported, so the branch is not re-merged (AGENTS.md multi-agent §10).

The first full run at `8eae1397` had 1 failed / 5202 passed: `normalized-call-sites.test.ts` named the new `readReplayedNothing(normalized` call site, which `4066e3ac` classifies.
